author: SickProdigy
description: Publish official Windrose Steam announcements as cards or article-style posts with configurable categories and role notifications.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild announcement settings and bounded Steam announcement IDs. It does not persistently store user data or metadata.
install_msg: Set an announcement channel with `[p]windroseset channel #channel`, choose `[p]windroseset mode card` or `[p]windroseset mode article`, optionally set a notification role, then start automatic posting with `[p]windroseset autopost start`. Existing Steam posts are seeded during setup and will not flood the channel.
name: Windrose
